findings.label: Finalize now gated on a valid rate
findings.detail: The Finalize button is disabled until chosenRate parses to > 1; if the live-rate feed fails and the draft has no prior rate, the field stays empty and the admin must type a rate before finalizing. This is the intended feature behavior but changes the old 'finalize always worked with no rate' path. Confirm it is acceptable that a draft can no longer be finalized without an explicit rate.

findings.label: 1-arg overload self-invocation bypasses proxy
findings.detail: finalizeInvoice(Long) delegates to the annotated 2-arg method via this, bypassing the Spring proxy, so a future caller of the 1-arg version would get no @Transactional/@CacheEvict. Not a live issue since the controller calls the 2-arg method directly; worth a note if other callers are added later.
